reading.title: Scorpio Lunation with Venus-Mars Sextile
overview: The Sun stands at 18° Scorpio with the recent new moon at 17° Scorpio. The Moon at 6° Sagittarius is out of bounds and applies next to a sextile with Venus. Mercury is retrograde at 6° Scorpio while Venus, in its rulership at 23° Libra retrograde, forms a tight sextile to Mars at 23° Leo.

Uranus at 4° Gemini retrograde trines Pluto at 3° Aquarius, Neptune at 2° Aries retrograde sextiles Pluto, and Mars conjoins Jupiter at 25° Leo. These configurations occur against the backdrop of the Scorpio lunation falling in the third house for the United States and the twelfth house for Russia, Ukraine and Israel.

Mundane tradition associates the Venus-Mars sextile with alliances under tension and resources directed toward defense, the Uranus-Pluto trine with structural upheaval, and the Mars-Jupiter conjunction with expansive campaigns. The Scorpio lunation places emphasis on communications for the United States and on hidden matters for Russia, Ukraine and Israel.

nations.reading: Transiting Neptune opposes the Sibly MC within 1.03° and squares natal Venus within 1.2°, while Jupiter opposes the natal Moon within 1.77°. Saturn sextiles natal Uranus within 0.2°. These contacts coincide with reporting on the Pentagon chief facing impeachment proceedings.

Transiting Neptune squares the natal Sun within 1.48° and Pluto conjoins natal Saturn within 1.94°. Uranus trines natal Saturn within 0.86°. The Scorpio lunation falls in the twelfth house; reporting notes renewed peace-talk efforts and the decline of an independent newspaper.

Transiting Pluto opposes the natal Moon within 1.13° and Mars squares the natal Sun within 0.26°. Uranus sextiles the natal Moon within 0.06°. The new moon is in the twelfth house; reporting covers the swearing-in of a new parliament.

Transiting Saturn squares the natal Sun within 0.67° and Uranus opposes natal Jupiter within 0.27°. Jupiter trines natal Mercury within 0.07°. Prediction markets on the 2026 local elections show elevated activity under the Uranus-Pluto trine.

reading.lore_and_intel: Venus sextile Mars overlaps with reporting on Israel's new parliament and interoperability gaps in joint operations; Uranus trine Pluto overlaps with Taiwan election markets; Mars conjunction Jupiter overlaps with Lithuanian grain checks and UK drone networks for Russian submarines; Mercury square Pluto overlaps with Maldives' reported ban on Israeli passports. No overlap appears for the Neptune opposition to the US MC beyond the Hegseth coverage already noted, and several listed aspects lack corresponding dated reporting.

reading.the_test: Records over thousands of days show Mars afflictions, full moons and eclipses perform no better than chance against Ukraine air-raid alarms, Israeli alerts, Russian losses and worldwide magnitude-6+ earthquakes. The largest recorded deviation is a non-significant +35% for full moons versus Israeli alerts (p=0.24 corrected). All tested claims remain within chance expectation.
